_doc: NPC clans (FAM-009, NpcClans). Each clan is founded when a game starts (or an older save loads) as generated NPCs: a head, the head's spouse and children, all with the clan surname, living in the clan's region. Members are the head's spouses and descendants (Clans.sync_family); when the head dies the heir succeeds (Clans.succeed, FAM-008), and a clan whose line ends is extinct. Per clan: id, name, surname, region (regions.json id), description, optional alignment (all members), head: {gender (optional, rolled if missing), age_years, realm, stage}, spouse: {age_years, realm}, children: {count: [min, max], age_years: [min, max], realm}. Realms are realm ids. relations (FAM-009b): each clan's standing toward the player (and the player's clan) and toward the other clans, from min to max. start: [{clans: [id, id], value}] starting relation between two clans (both ways; unlisted pairs and the player start at 0). acts: karma.json act id -> relation change toward the player when the act targets a member (attempted or done). kindness: karma.json gratitude source (gift, treat_npc) -> relation gain when done for a member. marriage: relation gain both ways when a marriage first binds two clans into an alliance (a member wed to the player or to a member of the player's clan, or to a member of another clan). standings: ascending [{min, name, favor_scale, grudge (optional)}]; a clan's standing is the last whose min the value reaches. favor_scale multiplies favor gained with its members (chat, gifts, courting); grudge: on falling to that standing every living member holds at least that grudge against the player (Karma).

clans.name: Zhao Clan
clans.description: The landlords of Qingshi Village. Their patriarch once served an outer sect and came home to farm spirit rice.

clans.name: Mo Clan
clans.description: Merchants of the Fallen Star Market whose ledgers hide debts written in blood.

clans.name: Yun Clan
clans.description: An old sword clan dwelling among the clouds of Azure Peak, proud of a Foundation patriarch.
